newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga restarts Vigdis oil production.
newsitem.headline: Saga restarts Vigdis oil production.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Thursday it had resumed producing crude at the Vigdis oilfield in the North Sea, and gas output would probably begin on Sunday.
"We have the production running now and we are producing five to 6,000 cubic metres per day (31,500-37,750 barrels per day)," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters.
"But we haven't started the gas compressor yet because we have to warm the system up first. Gas will probably come on Sunday."
Vigdis was closed down on May 23 after a gas leak was detected in the compressor train, which was traced back to a design fault. It was originally expected to restart at the end of June.
